#ctDNA Detection rate by Stage and Window

#Baseline
rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")
circ_data$ctDNA.Base <- factor(circ_data$ctDNA.Base, levels=c("NEGATIVE","POSITIVE"))
circ_data$Stage <- factor(circ_data$Stage, levels=c("I","II","III","IV"))
circ_data <- subset(circ_data, ctDNA.Base %in% c("NEGATIVE", "POSITIVE"))
positive_counts_by_stage <- aggregate(circ_data$ctDNA.Base == "POSITIVE", by=list(circ_data$Stage), FUN=sum)
total_counts_by_stage <- aggregate(circ_data$ctDNA.Base, by=list(circ_data$Stage), FUN=length)
combined_data <- data.frame(
  Stage = total_counts_by_stage$Group.1,
  Total_Count = total_counts_by_stage$x,
  Positive_Count = positive_counts_by_stage$x,
  Rate = (positive_counts_by_stage$x / total_counts_by_stage$x) * 100  # Convert to percentage
)
combined_data$Rate <- sprintf("%.2f%%", combined_data$Rate)
overall_total_count <- nrow(circ_data)
overall_positive_count <- nrow(circ_data[circ_data$ctDNA.Base == "POSITIVE",])
overall_positivity_rate <- (overall_positive_count / overall_total_count) * 100  # Convert to percentage
overall_row <- data.frame(
  Stage = "Overall",
  Total_Count = overall_total_count,
  Positive_Count = overall_positive_count,
  Rate = sprintf("%.2f%%", overall_positivity_rate)
)
combined_data <- rbind(combined_data, overall_row)
print(combined_data)
    Stage Total_Count Positive_Count    Rate
1       I           3              2  66.67%
2      II           7              7 100.00%
3     III          19             19 100.00%
4      IV           5              5 100.00%
5 Overall          34             33  97.06%

#Demographics Table

rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")

circ_data_subset <- circ_data %>%
  select(
    Age,
    Sex,
    ECOG,
    Location,
    Stage,
    Resection,
    pGrade,
    Recurrence,
    OS.Event,
    OS.months) %>%
  mutate(
    Age = as.numeric(Age),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    ECOG = factor(ECOG, levels = c("0", "1")),
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Lt", "Mt", "Ut")),
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("I","II","III","IV")),
    Resection = factor(Resection, levels = c("R0","R1")),
    pGrade = factor(pGrade, levels = c("Grade0","Grade1","Grade2","Grade3")),
    Recurrence = factor(Recurrence, levels = c("TRUE","FALSE")),
    OS.Event = factor(OS.Event, levels = c("TRUE","FALSE")),
    OS.months = as.numeric(OS.months))
table1 <- circ_data_subset %>%
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({min} - {max})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")) %>%
  bold_labels()

#Heatmap with Clinical & Genomics Factors

rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")
circ_data <- circ_data %>% arrange(Stage)
circ_datadf <- as.data.frame(circ_data)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Stage = circ_data$Stage,
  Sex = circ_data$Sex,
  Location = circ_data$Location,
  Grade = circ_data$Grade,
  ctDNA.Base = circ_data$ctDNA.Base,
  ctDNA.postNAC = circ_data$ctDNA.postNAC,
  ctDNA.MRD = circ_data$ctDNA.MRD,
  ctDNA.surveillance = circ_data$ctDNA.surveillance,
  EFS.Event = circ_data$EFS.Event,
  OS.Event = circ_data$OS.Event,
  
  col = list(Stage = c("I" = "seagreen1", "II" = "seagreen", "III" = "orange", "IV" = "purple"),
    Sex = c("Female" = "goldenrod" , "Male" = "blue4"),
    Location = c("Lt" = "brown", "Mt" = "darkgreen", "Ut" = "orange4"),
    Grade = c("Grade1b/2/3" = "cornflowerblue", "Grade0/1a" ="darkmagenta"),
    ctDNA.Base = c("POSITIVE" = "red3", "NEGATIVE" ="blue"),
    ctDNA.postNAC = c("POSITIVE" = "red3", "NEGATIVE" ="blue"),
    ctDNA.MRD = c("POSITIVE" = "red3", "NEGATIVE" ="blue"),
    EFS.Event = c("TRUE" = "red3", "FALSE" ="blue"),
    OS.Event = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" ="gray")    
))
ht <- Heatmap(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(circ_data$Stage)),show_row_names = FALSE,cluster_rows = F,cluster_columns = FALSE, top_annotation = ha)
pdf("heatmap.pdf",width = 7, height = 7)
draw(ht, annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()

#Overview Plot

setwd("~/Downloads") 
clinstage<- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_OP.csv")
clinstage_df<- as.data.frame(clinstage)

#Display the swimmer plot with the label box
oplot<-swimmer_plot(df=clinstage_df,
                    id='PatientName',
                    end='fu.diff.months',
                    fill='gray',
                    width=.01,
                    base_size = 14)
oplot <- oplot + theme(panel.border = element_blank())
oplot <- oplot + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-12, 48, by = 6))
oplot <- oplot + labs(x ="Patients" , y="Months from Enrolment")
oplot



##plot events
oplot_ev1 <- oplot + swimmer_points(df_points=clinstage_df,
                                    id='PatientName',
                                    time='date.diff.months',
                                    name_shape ='Event_type',
                                    name_col = 'Event',
                                    size=3.5,fill='black',
                                    #col='darkgreen'
)
oplot_ev1


#Shape customization to Event_type

oplot_ev1.1 <- oplot_ev1 + ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(name="Event_type",values=c(1,16,6,18,4),breaks=c('ctDNA_neg','ctDNA_pos', 'Imaging','Surgery', 'Death'))

oplot_ev1.1


#plot treatment

oplot_ev2 <- oplot_ev1.1 + swimmer_lines(df_lines=clinstage_df,
                                         id='PatientName',
                                         start='Tx_start.months',
                                         end='Tx_end.months',
                                         name_col='Tx_type',
                                         size=3.5,
                                         name_alpha = 1.0)

oplot_ev2

#Association of ctDNA status with Pathological N status

rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")

circ_data$ctDNA.postNAC <- factor(circ_data$ctDNA.postNAC, levels = c("NEGATIVE", "POSITIVE"), labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
circ_data$pN.stage <- factor(circ_data$pN.stage, levels = c("N0", "N1-N3"), labels = c("N0", "N1-N3"))
contingency_table <- table(circ_data$pN.stage, circ_data$ctDNA.postNAC)
chi_square_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print(chi_square_test)

    Pearson's Chi-squared test with Yates' continuity correction

data:  contingency_table
X-squared = 3.4977, df = 1, p-value = 0.06145
fisher_exact_test <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
print(fisher_exact_test)

    Fisher's Exact Test for Count Data

p-value = 0.04638
alternative hypothesis: true odds ratio is not equal to 1
95 percent confidence interval:
   0.9734627 471.1789080
sample estimates:
odds ratio 
  9.250939 
print(contingency_table)
       
        Negative Positive
  N0           9        1
  N1-N3       10       11
table_df <- as.data.frame(contingency_table)
table_df$Total <- ave(table_df$Freq, table_df$Var1, FUN = sum)
table_df$Percentage <- table_df$Freq / table_df$Total
table_df$MiddlePercentage <- table_df$Percentage / 2
ggplot(table_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Percentage, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(y = MiddlePercentage, label = Freq), position = "stack", color = "black", vjust = 1.5, size = 7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "ctDNA status", 
       x = "Pathological N status", 
       y = "Patients (%)", 
       fill = "ctDNA post-NAC",
       caption = paste("Fisher's exact test p-value: ", format.pval(fisher_exact_test$p.value))) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "blue", "Positive" = "red")) + # define custom colors

  ))

contingency_table <- table(circ_data$pN.stage, circ_data$ctDNA.clearance)
chi_square_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print(chi_square_test)

  N1-N3        10           11
table_df <- as.data.frame(contingency_table)
table_df$Total <- ave(table_df$Freq, table_df$Var1, FUN = sum)
table_df$Percentage <- table_df$Freq / table_df$Total
table_df$MiddlePercentage <- table_df$Percentage / 2
ggplot(table_df, aes(x = Var1, y = Percentage, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(y = MiddlePercentage, label = Freq), position = "stack", color = "black", vjust = 1.5, size = 7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "ctDNA clearance", 
       x = "Pathological N Stage", 
       y = "Patients (%)", 
       fill = "ctDNA Clearance",
       caption = paste("Fisher's exact test p-value: ", format.pval(fisher_exact_test$p.value))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Clearance" = "blue", "No Clearance" = "red")) + # define custom colors
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1.5, size = 14), # increase x-axis text size
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), # increase y-axis text size
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), # increase x-axis label size
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"), # increase y-axis label size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"))  # increase Recurrence label size

#Association of ctDNA dynamics with Pathological N status

rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")

circ_data$ctDNA.Dynamics <- NA #first we create the variable for the ctDNA & NAC combination, and we assign values
circ_data <- circ_data %>%
  mutate(ctDNA.Dynamics = case_when(
    ctDNA.Base == "POSITIVE" & ctDNA.postNAC == "NEGATIVE" & ctDNA.MRD == "NEGATIVE" ~ "ctDNA +/-/-",
    ctDNA.Base == "POSITIVE" & ctDNA.postNAC == "POSITIVE" & ctDNA.MRD == "NEGATIVE" ~ "ctDNA +/+/-",
    ctDNA.Base == "POSITIVE" & ctDNA.postNAC == "POSITIVE" & ctDNA.MRD == "POSITIVE" ~ "ctDNA +/+/+"
  ))

circ_data$ctDNA.Dynamics <- factor(circ_data$ctDNA.Dynamics, levels=c("ctDNA +/-/-", "ctDNA +/+/-", "ctDNA +/+/+"))
circ_data$pN.stage <- factor(circ_data$pN.stage, levels = c("N0", "N1-N3"), labels = c("N0", "N1-N3"))
contingency_table <- table(circ_data$ctDNA.Dynamics, circ_data$pN.stage)
chi_square_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
print(chi_square_test)

rm(list=ls())
setwd("~/Downloads")
circ_data <- read.csv("Keio Neo FLOT_Clinical Data.csv")
circ_data <- circ_data[circ_data$ctDNA.MRD!="",]

circ_data$ctDNA.MRD <- factor(circ_data$ctDNA.MRD, levels=c("NEGATIVE","POSITIVE"), labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
circ_data$Sex <- factor(circ_data$Sex, levels=c("Female","Male"))
circ_data$ECOG <- factor(circ_data$ECOG, levels = c("0", "1"))
circ_data$Location <- factor(circ_data$Location, levels=c("Ut","Mt","Lt"))
circ_data$StageGroup <- factor(circ_data$StageGroup, levels=c("I-II","III-IV"))
circ_data$Grade <- factor(circ_data$Grade, levels=c("Grade1b/2/3","Grade0/1a"))
surv_object <- Surv(time = circ_data$EFS.months, event = circ_data$EFS.Event) 
cox_fit <- coxph(surv_object ~ ctDNA.MRD + Age + StageGroup + Grade, data=circ_data) 
ggforest(cox_fit, data = circ_data, main = "Multivariate Regression Model for PFS", refLabel = "Reference Group")

test.ph <- cox.zph(cox_fit)
